title: Millennium Eruption of Paektu (Changbaishan)
summary: The Millennium Eruption of Paektu (Changbaishan), a volcano on the China-North Korea border, ranks among the largest eruptions of the Common Era. A radiocarbon signal in a larch killed by pyroclastic currents, combined with Greenland ice evidence, dates it to late 946 CE. A USGS-hosted study gives about 23 km3 dense rock equivalent. The date rules out a role in the collapse of the Bohai Kingdom.

uncertainty.note: Oppenheimer et al. (2017) date it to late 946 CE; earlier estimates had no consensus across at least the tenth century CE.
